sql: SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*Olpasiran therapy significantly reduced lipoprotein\\(a\\) concentrations[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '36342163' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%Olpasiran therapy significantly reduced lipoprotein(a) concentrations%' LIMIT 5
rows:
Conclusions

Olpasiran therapy significantly reduced lipoprotein(a) concentrations in patients with established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease
